name: medal_frame
purpose: Blank achievement medal frame for a Japanese landing page: text (label, big number) will be overlaid in HTML, so the inside must be completely empty.
subject: a front-view circular gold laurel-wreath medal badge: a thin double gold ring forming the outer circle, a wreath of two laurel branches hugging the ring's left and right sides, perfectly mirror-symmetrical left to right, branches rising from a small gold ribbon bow at the bottom center and ending near the top center with a small gap; a large perfectly circular empty inner disc filled with soft white-to-cream (#fff6cf) gradient, about 62% of the badge diameter, no text
composition: exactly centered, the badge fills about 94% of the canvas width and height, equal margins on all four sides, left and right halves identical mirror images, circle perfectly round
background: pure flat white (#ffffff) background, nothing else, no shadow outside the badge
style: clean vector-like flat illustration with subtle metallic gold gradients and a soft inner highlight, crisp edges, premium advertising quality
text_rule: Do not render any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark anywhere.
